picks.title: Medium's new TK app brings AI assistance directly into the writing process
picks.rationale: New product launch: Medium ships a standalone writing app with built-in AI assistance, a concrete tool writers can try now amid the AI-authorship backlash.
picks.excerpt: Medium's new writing app embraces AI-assisted writing, despite growing controversy over the technology's role in publishing.

picks.title: Authors Can Defend Against AI Allegations With ‘Paper Trail’ Tools. Is It Enough?
picks.rationale: Actionable for writers: surveys the provenance/paper-trail tools authors can use to prove human authorship as AI-detection accusations spread through publishing.
picks.excerpt: As the publishing industry wrestles with paranoia over the provenance of manuscripts, writers are caught in an impossible bind.

picks.title: 예스24, 한영 문장 한 목소리로 읽는다…인공지능 TTS 도입
picks.rationale: New feature release: Yes24 adds on-device AI TTS that reads mixed Korean-English e-book sentences in a single voice, with 8 AI voices.
picks.excerpt: 오디오북 1인당 구매액 69.3% 증가…40대 비중 30.9% 온디바이스 음성합성 적용…AI 보이스 총 8종 제공 예스24가 전자책에서 한국어와 영어가 섞인 문장을 한 목소리로 읽어주는 인공지능 음성변환 기능을 도입했다고 10일 밝혔다.

picks.title: Japan initiative aims to protect rights holders in generative AI era
picks.rationale: New initiative: Japan moves to bring manga, anime and other cultural IP into generative AI on terms set by rights holders — a licensing-framework shift for publishers.
picks.excerpt: Japan is seeking to bring its anime, manga, music and other cultural properties into the age of generative artificial intelligence on terms set by rights holders.

picks.title: 플리토, AI 학습용 출판데이터 공급…정제·품질 검증 지원
picks.rationale: New deal: Flitto signs an MOU with the Korean Publishers Association to build a licensed market for AI-training publishing data, handling cleaning and quality checks.
picks.excerpt: 플리토가 출판 저작물을 인공지능(AI) 학습에 활용할 수 있도록 데이터 공급 체계 마련에 나섰다. 플리토는 지난 4일 대한출판문화협회와 AI 학습용 출판데이터 공급·거래 시장 조성을 위한 업무협약을 체결했다고 9일 밝혔다.
